_comment: B2-G1/G2 caps, measured 2026-11-11 from assets/sprites/art-data.mjs (4,186 entries). battleCanvas: all 2,262 battle entries (1,018 base fronts/backs + 1,244 -bob/-accent companions) measured on 64x64, zero exceptions. maxOver16ColorEntries: 116 entries materialize to >16 used colors (max 21); the ceiling is shrink-only — new art must be <=16 colors. Enforced by scripts/art-gate.mjs.
_kit_comment: Gassasin kit registry (assets/sprites/kit-art-data.mjs, CC-BY 3.0): the B2-G2 16-color discipline applies per entry with NO exceedance allowance — the kit pipeline quantizes to <=16 colors at slice time (build-kit-art.mjs), so any kit entry over the cap is a pipeline bug, not a legacy freeze. Kit tiles are 16x16; kit character frames are 16x32 (the overworld sprite format).
